target: Teach another learner to reason about working memory using a bounded scratchpad controller. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Teach working memory — human review
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about working memory using a bounded scratchpad controller. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: task success under a fixed state budget
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: carrying stale state into a new task

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a bounded scratchpad controller.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report task success under a fixed state budget with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: carrying stale state into a new task.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of working memory.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report task success under a fixed state budget against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for carrying stale state into a new task; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
